about.title: About Me
about.paragraph1: I study Software Engineering at UPC (eighth semester). I build websites and web applications for businesses, organizations, and team projects.
about.paragraph2: My freelance work involves building websites and their functionality. I have also developed individual and team projects at university.
about.paragraph3: I have five months of professional backend experience at Devdatep Consulting, working with APIs, databases, and integrations for EmiteFacil. That experience complements my work as a Full Stack developer.

freelance.title: Client websites
freelance.subtitle: Websites I built for businesses and organizations.

internship.bullet1: Design and implementation of RESTful APIs using Laravel 11 and PHP 8.2 under a Service-Oriented Architecture (SOA) applying Repository and DTO patterns.
internship.bullet2: Integration of digital signatures and SOAP/XML communications with SUNAT for the EmiteFacil electronic billing SaaS platform.
internship.bullet3: Automated validation of fiscal tax identifiers (RUC, DNI) via government APIs.
internship.bullet4: Token-based session authentication with Laravel Sanctum and relational database design in MySQL.
